hypothesis: A valid principal may cross the tenant boundary by substituting an object identifier.

proposed_tests.objective: Exercise object identifiers owned by a different tenant and require denial without disclosing object state.

oracle.expected: Every foreign-tenant identifier is denied and produces no state change.

negative_control.description: The same principal can access an equivalent object owned by its own tenant.

mutation_validation.description: Removing the tenant predicate causes the generated test to fail.
